acceptance.claimBoundary: Acceptance proves that the applied convergence snapshot is invalidated by critical authority additions or changes; it does not ratify the changed authority.
evidenceRequired: Regression tests cover added, changed, and missing critical authority after convergence.
Metrics, experiments, journeys, principles, architecture, backlog, requirements, vision, and instructions participate in the drift state.

completionCriteria: Adding, changing, or removing a critical authority after convergence produces DRIFT_DETECTED.
The design gate locks and identifies the exact changed paths and roles requiring review.
New metrics and experiments invalidate convergence just as changed journeys or architecture do.
Only an explicit repository-owner review and new convergence snapshot can restore readiness.
nonObjectives: Do not ratify authority changes automatically.
Do not preserve a READY result after its evidence snapshot changes.
Do not collapse all authority changes into an untraceable aggregate score.
objective: Invalidate prior convergence whenever critical product or governance authority drifts.
title: Invalidate convergence on critical authority drift
